name: Thunder Brawl
fix_description: In claimReward, follow checks-effects-interactions pattern: update the reward state (zero out pending rewards) before making the external call to transfer tokens. Alternatively, add a nonReentrant modifier to prevent re-entry.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is not just a trivial single-call bug: it uses a flash loan, AMM reserve math, and repeated Pair.skim() calls to manipulate token balances/reserves before swapping back for profit. An experienced auditor could reproduce it without extreme protocol internals, but it still requires understanding UniswapV2 pair accounting and a multi-step attack flow.
